notes.subject: טרפה
notes.rationale: טרפה: mit bilong animal ol narapela animal i kichim na wokim pen — 'animal i dai long pen' o 'mit i no gut'; JPS 'torn of beasts'.

notes.subject: therefore
notes.rationale: JPS i putim 'therefore' namel long tu hap; Hibru i no gat tok connect long olsem.

notes.subject: long Mi
notes.rationale: Yahwe i tok dairek long ol man Yisrael — yupela i mas stap ol man holi bilong em.

translation: Na ol man holi yupela i save stap bilong Mi; na mit bilong animal i dai na ol birua i kaikaiim pinis long gaden — yupela no ken kaikai; long dok yupela mas trowim ⟨את⟩ em aweg.

tokens.gloss: bilong animal i dai na ol birua i kaikaiim pinis
